strings.en: The save data could not be written.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}The backup memory has failed, or{NEWLINE}the Game Card has worn out.{NEWLINE}You can keep playing, but you{NEWLINE}won’t be able to save.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Please turn off the power.
